### Unsaid Words Hang Still
### Singer-songwriter folk, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, subtle piano, upright bass, brushed drums, close unpolished intimate vocal, sparse exposed sound, 80 BPM
### LYRICS
[Intro]
Just the wood and my breath
Just the quiet in the room

[Verse]
I kept rehearsing what I'd say
The perfect little turning phrase

[Chorus]
If we had just talked it through
Would the silence feel so deep

[Outro]
Still just the quiet now
### ARTWORK
A single bare tree stands against a pale, overcast sky.
